name: flashcard-studio
description: Flip supplied pairs, review, and print cut-out cards.

interface.longDescription: Learning flashcard maker for supplied question-answer pairs. Flip cards, mark Known or Practice again, and filter your review. Print paired question-answer cut-out cards in an A4 or Letter vector PDF, or import the headerless UTF-8 CSV as Front and Back. Identical pairs are removed; different answers to the same question remain. This tool does not invent answers, check facts, provide spaced repetition or sync progress. Review ratings remain in the current widget session and are self-assessments. Up to 24 supplied cards in a 2,800-byte payload. The PDF prints Latin with accents, Greek, Cyrillic and Vietnamese; scripts its font lacks (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Indic and emoji) show as [?]. Widget and CSV preserve Unicode. Formula-like CSV cells receive a protective apostrophe; import as plain text with HTML disabled.
defaultPrompt: Make flashcards for Spanish greetings: hello = hola; thank you = gracias.
Print Letter flashcards for my supplied pairs: 2 + 2 = 4; 3 + 3 = 6; 4 + 4 = 8; 5 + 5 = 10.
Make flashcards from these pairs and remove duplicates: hello = hola; hello = hola.

positive.prompt: Make flashcards for Spanish greetings: hello = hola; thank you = gracias.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_flashcard_deck with the 2 supplied pairs and a title such as "Spanish greetings": 2 cards; 0 duplicate pairs removed. 1 A4 PDF page. Supplied answers were not fact-checked. Review progress stays in this widget session. CSV has no header: import column one as Front and column two as Back. Leading formula characters receive a protective apostrophe; import as plain text, with HTML disabled. The widget shows the supplied cards with Reveal answer, Known and Practice again controls; the PDF and CSV download links open.

positive.prompt: Print Letter flashcards for my supplied pairs: 2 + 2 = 4; 3 + 3 = 6; 4 + 4 = 8; 5 + 5 = 10.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_flashcard_deck with the 4 supplied pairs and paper Letter (the title may be model-chosen, for example "Arithmetic pairs"): 4 cards; 0 duplicate pairs removed. 2 Letter PDF pages. Supplied answers were not fact-checked. Review progress stays in this widget session. CSV has no header: import column one as Front and column two as Back. Leading formula characters receive a protective apostrophe; import as plain text, with HTML disabled. The widget shows the supplied cards with Reveal answer, Known and Practice again controls; the PDF and CSV download links open.

positive.prompt: Make flashcards from these pairs and remove duplicates: hello = hola; hello = hola.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_flashcard_deck with both supplied pairs: 1 card; 1 duplicate pair removed. 1 A4 PDF page. Supplied answers were not fact-checked. Review progress stays in this widget session. Identical question-answer pairs were removed; different answers to the same question remain separate. CSV has no header: import column one as Front and column two as Back. Leading formula characters receive a protective apostrophe; import as plain text, with HTML disabled. The widget shows the supplied cards with Reveal answer, Known and Practice again controls; the PDF and CSV download links open.

positive.prompt: Make flashcards from my pairs: bank = financial institution; bank = river edge. Keep both meanings.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_flashcard_deck with both supplied pairs: 2 cards; 0 duplicate pairs removed. 1 A4 PDF page. Supplied answers were not fact-checked. Review progress stays in this widget session. CSV has no header: import column one as Front and column two as Back. Leading formula characters receive a protective apostrophe; import as plain text, with HTML disabled. The widget shows the supplied cards with Reveal answer, Known and Practice again controls; the PDF and CSV download links open.

positive.prompt: Make printable flashcards from my supplied pairs: Zażółć = 日本語; café = coffee. Keep Unicode in CSV.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_flashcard_deck with both supplied pairs: 2 cards; 0 duplicate pairs removed. 1 A4 PDF page. The PDF prints "Zażółć" and "café" with their accents and shows "日本語" as [?]. Supplied answers were not fact-checked. Review progress stays in this widget session. Some text uses characters the PDF font cannot print (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Indic scripts or emoji); in the PDF they show as [?]. Full text is preserved in the widget and UTF-8 CSV. Accented Latin, Greek, Cyrillic and Vietnamese print normally. CSV has no header: import column one as Front and column two as Back. Leading formula characters receive a protective apostrophe; import as plain text, with HTML disabled. The widget shows the supplied cards with Reveal answer, Known and Practice again controls; the PDF and CSV download links open.

negative.description: A factual explanation does not require exporting supplied pairs.

negative.prompt: Generate answers for my exam tomorrow.
negative.description: Do not generate learning answers or exams.

negative.prompt: Schedule spaced repetition across my devices.
negative.description: Cross-device scheduling and synced progress are outside scope.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.2: Renamed to Zovo Flashcards, published by Zovo (zovo.one). The site, widget header and download file names (zovo-flashcards.pdf and .csv) use the new name. Tools, inputs and outputs are unchanged.

pl-PL.subtitle: Fiszki do nauki i druku
pl-PL.description: Przeglądaj własne pytania i odpowiedzi, odwracaj fiszki i zaznaczaj postęp. Pobierz PDF z parami do wycięcia lub CSV do importu. Nie tworzymy ani nie sprawdzamy treści. Postęp jest dostępny tylko w bieżącej sesji widżetu. W PDF nieobsługiwane pisma (np. chińskie, japońskie, arabskie, emoji) są wyświetlane jako [?]; CSV zachowuje Unicode.

de-DE.subtitle: Lernkarten prüfen und drucken
de-DE.description: Prüfen Sie eigene Frage-Antwort-Paare, drehen Sie Karten um und markieren Sie Ihren Fortschritt. Laden Sie ein PDF mit zusammengehörenden Karten zum Ausschneiden oder eine CSV zum Import herunter. Inhalte werden nicht erstellt oder überprüft. Fortschritt bleibt in der aktuellen Widget-Sitzung. Im PDF erscheinen nicht unterstützte Schriften (z. B. Chinesisch, Japanisch, Arabisch, Emoji) als [?]; CSV erhält Unicode.

es-ES.subtitle: Repasar e imprimir tarjetas
es-ES.description: Repasa tus preguntas y respuestas, gira tarjetas y marca tu progreso. Descarga un PDF con pares recortables o un CSV para importar. No generamos ni verificamos el contenido. El progreso permanece en la sesión actual del widget. En el PDF, las escrituras no admitidas (p. ej., chino, japonés, árabe, emoji) aparecen como [?]; el CSV conserva Unicode.

fr-FR.subtitle: Fiches à réviser et imprimer
fr-FR.description: Révisez vos propres questions et réponses, retournez les fiches et marquez votre progression. Téléchargez un PDF de paires à découper ou un CSV à importer. Le contenu n’est ni créé ni vérifié. La progression reste dans la session du widget. Dans le PDF, les écritures non prises en charge (chinois, japonais, arabe, emoji, etc.) s’affichent comme [?] ; le CSV conserve Unicode.

ja-JP.subtitle: 学習カードの復習と印刷
ja-JP.description: 入力した質問と答えをカードで復習し、進捗を記録できます。切り抜き用の質問と答えのペアをPDFで、インポート用データをCSVで出力します。内容の作成や事実確認は行いません。進捗は現在のウィジェットセッション内のみです。PDFでは対応していない文字（中国語・日本語・アラビア語・絵文字など）が[?]と表示され、CSVはUnicodeを保持します。

pt-BR.subtitle: Revisar e imprimir cartões
pt-BR.description: Revise suas perguntas e respostas, vire os cartões e marque o progresso. Baixe um PDF com pares para recortar ou um CSV para importar. Não geramos nem verificamos o conteúdo. O progresso fica na sessão atual do widget. No PDF, escritas não suportadas (por exemplo, chinês, japonês, árabe, emoji) aparecem como [?]; o CSV preserva Unicode.
